bugs_found: fx_convert converts the exchange rate to float before multiplying by Decimal, which raises TypeError for most inputs and loses precision; use Decimal(str(rate)) instead.
transfer does not normalize amount to Decimal like the other functions, so float inputs can cause Decimal arithmetic TypeError and Receipt.amount may have an unexpected type.
apply_fee can return a negative net amount when fee_min or fee_max exceeds the amount; financial fee application should usually cap the fee at the amount or reject such bounds.
